offers_products.reason: Manufactures MasterCraft wakesurf, wakeboard and ski boats and trailers, plus other brands such as Crest pontoons and Balise.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from building and selling boats; only dealer support and warranty accompany the product.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Recreational boat owners choose and receive the boats, with customization in the design center.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells boats through a network of authorized dealers, who buy them for resale.

recurring_revenue.reason: Boats are bought once every several years; sales are one-off dealer orders, not subscriptions or consumables.

cyclical_demand.reason: Premium recreational boats are discretionary purchases that buyers can postpone in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Premium towboats are large, infrequent purchases for the buyer.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured boats and their technology, not for staff time.

large_customers.reason: Buyers are individual boat owners and independent dealers, not large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Runs boat and trailer manufacturing plants in-house, so it needs ongoing investment in facilities and tooling.

notes: Website text covers only the MasterCraft brand; other brands (Crest, Balise, Aviara) come from prior knowledge.
